cv.intro: Computer Engineer and AI Developer with over 5 years of experience in software development. Extensive experience in web development, machine learning, computer vision, and artificial intelligence. Skilled in database management systems, including design, normalization, migration, and optimization. Currently working as an AI Developer at ESPOL, specializing in Deep Learning and Mamba-based architectures. Completed a Master's in Artificial Intelligence at UNIR, focusing on advanced AI techniques and data-driven solutions. Experienced in modern technologies such as Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, React, and Docker, delivering scalable solutions through innovation.

home.presentation: I am from Guayaquil, Ecuador, and hold a Computer Engineering degree from ESPOL University, along with a Master's in Artificial Intelligence from UNIR. Currently working as an AI Developer at ESPOL, I specialize in computer vision and deep learning. Beyond code, I enjoy playing guitar, soccer, photography, and traveling. I thrive in collaborative environments and am passionate about building innovative solutions that push the boundaries of technology!
